title: The Episode About the First Sikh Guni

blocks.text: Mullahs and qazis said that Baba Ji had broken the ordinary bounds of religion, and many became intensely curious about him. (41)
People began to say that he was a perfect, God-realized person and that whole households were becoming his disciples. (42)
To both Hindus and Muslims he became a teacher of truth, restraining oppression and guiding people toward justice. (43)
